text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Crown Prince Hassan calls for a broad definition of the term security, says "cannot imagine Middle East peace progress without the implementation of the Hebron accord and pushing ahead on the Syrian and Lebanese tracks."
- Jordanian-Israeli ministerial trade committee meets on Wednesday to discuss the expansion of customs exempted goods and means of eliminating hurdles to Jordanian-Palestinian trade.
- Prime Minister Kabariti's meeting with the Iraqi trade minister pushes stock market activity and prices rise.
- Campaign against Israeli industries exhibition escalates.
- King Hussein visits the United Arab Emirates on Saturday.
- A joint Jordanian-Dutch business council to be set up.
- Jordan stresses need to bring old "Mideast into new world," reminds Israel that peace needs to be built on exchange of land for peace.
- Israel to allow Jordanian trucks to carry cement to Palestinians.
